text:
emily_cs: Heads up — Mosaic (retail) showing an onboarding stall and procurement has paused. Noticed a pattern: power users falling silent + new ML hire coming in who wants to re-evaluate vendors. Sharing notes below.

system-bot: :rotating_light: Usage alert for Mosaic — generation tokens down 37% WoW, 3 power users dropped to zero activity. (auto-flag)

raj_ae: Thanks. Do we know why procurement paused? budget issue or feature ask?

emily_cs: Procurement paused pending the new ML lead's vendor review. Champion Jorge moved to Product last month. New hire (Ava) joined last week and asked for a short POC to compare cost + telemetry. Also saw these recent activity rows: 

```
user_id,calls_30d,last_active
u_101,0,2026-03-02
u_203,5,2026-03-18
u_305,0,2026-03-01
```

emily_cs: Top asks from their side: latency guarantees, cost/throughput numbers, and audit/traceability. They also want to see schema mapping for data connectors.

taylor_se: I can run two microbenchmarks and a short reproducible script. Plan: latency at 512 tokens (hosted vs dedicated), and cost delta using our int8 quantized profile. Will share numbers EOD.

zoe_onboarding: Onboarding status for Mosaic: 6/8 tasks complete. Remaining: data connector schema mapping + final security checklist. I shared quickstart but they want a walkthrough.

raj_ae: Proposal: offer a 30-day POC (dedicated pool) with 4 SE hours included, focused eval metrics they requested. Emily, can you lead the POC kickoff?

emily_cs: I can. Proposed kickoff agenda: 1) confirm success metrics (latency / cost / tracing) 2) define POC scope & samples 3) support & pricing 4) timeline. Taylor — can you demo quantization impact + live traces during the call?

taylor_se: Yes. I'll prepare: microbench results, a 2-step repro script, and a short slide that maps metrics to their business questions.

zoe_onboarding: I'll complete the schema mapping doc and add sample connector configs. Also would like a short list of priority personas from the new ML lead so we tailor the demo.

raj_ae: Intro sent to Ava (new ML lead). Ava replied: 'interested in POC focused on inference cost & monitoring. Available 3/25 10:00 PT for kickoff.'

emily_cs: Booking 3/25 10:00 PT — invite to include SE, onboarding, and a 30-min slot + pre-POC doc. Action items: SE to prep microbenchmarks (taylor), onboarding to finalize mapping (zoe), CS to pull usage & sample prompts (emily).

system-bot: :calendar: Reminder created for 2026-03-25 10:00 PT (Mosaic POC kickoff)

taylor_se: :thumbsup: I'll also attach the small script so they can run the same test in their environment.

emily_cs: One more ask: procurement flagged ATO/KMS requirements. @security-eng — can we surface the compliance spec and a short note on KMS integrations for the POC doc?

raj_ae: Noted. I'll loop Security and Legal into the invite.

zoe_onboarding: I'll add a checklist item for a security pre-call so we don't hit blockers mid-POC.

emily_cs: Thanks team — goal is to keep Mosaic engaged through a low-risk, measurable POC. Will post the kickoff doc in this thread when ready.

raj_ae: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

system-bot: :white_check_mark: Thread updated with action items and owners.
